subject.title: Route org publisher abuse nominations to org review

question: Should active org publisher abuse nominations always leave the automatic user-ban path and move to candidate_for_future_action for separate org or member enforcement?
rationale: The code is internally coherent, but choosing to remove org nominations from automated account enforcement defines a moderation and abuse-response boundary that tests cannot authorize.

options.title: Approve separated enforcement
options.body: Keep the branch’s org-specific routing and require staff operations to monitor and resolve candidate_for_future_action nominations through org suspension or responsible-member action.

options.title: Keep the draft pending
options.body: Do not land the policy until the repository has a clearer org-suspension workflow or an explicitly owned operational queue for these candidates.

recommendation.title: Approve separated enforcement
recommendation.body: Keep the branch’s org-specific routing and require staff operations to monitor and resolve candidate_for_future_action nominations through org suspension or responsible-member action.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest available feature-history owner for the publisher-abuse workflow and authored the adjacent moderation design work identified in the supplied history.
